

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Earth Goat|kanji=己未|romaji=tsuchinoto hitsuji|onyomi=kibi|p=jǐwèi|w=chi-wei|mi=t͡ɕi³⁵ weɪ̯|y=gei2 mei6|j=gei2 mei6|ci=kei mei|mc=kɨj mei|oc-bs=kɯʔ mei}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Earth Goat''' (己未, ''tsuchinoto hitsuji''; onyomi ''kibi'') is the 56th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 56th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Earth Horse|ja|戊午}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Metal Monkey|ja|庚申}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''己'' is Yin Earth, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''未'' (Goat) is Yin Earth; together they form a Biwa (Mutual Harmony) relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Earth Goat (己未)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): jǐwèi
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gei2 mei6
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: tsuchinoto-hitsuji
*** On'yomi: kibi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gimi (기미)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Kỷ Mùi

==Months of Yin Earth Goat==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 3 or 8 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Mizunoto (癸)|ja|癸|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui}} or {{ill|Tsuchinoe (戊)|ja|戊|lt=Tsuchinoe (戊)|2=ja|3=戊|4=zh|5=戊|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bo}}), the month of {{ill|June|en|June|qid=Q120|lt=June}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}} of {{ill|Yin Earth Goat|ja|己未|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kibi}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Xiaoshu|en|Xiaoshu|qid=Q1190976|lt=Minor Heat}} until the day before {{ill|Liqiu|en|Liqiu|qid=Q1147421|lt=Beginning of Autumn}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yin Earth Goat==
The {{ill|Senjitsu|ja|選日|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/selected day}} for {{ill|Yin Earth Goat|ja|己未|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kibi}} is as follows.
=== Selected Day (選日) ===
The day of {{ill|Yin Earth Goat|ja|己未|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kibi}} is the 5th day of {{ill|Hassen|ja|八専|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hassen}} (excluding gap days).
